summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2018-C2 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the replacement of the special servicer for the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan, which represents about 6.1% of the asset pool. Trimont LLC was removed and Green Loan Services LLC was appointed as successor special servicer, effective July 14, 2026, under the BBCMS 2018-CHRS TSA. No transaction terms, consideration, or premium are involved. This is a routine servicing update for a commercial mortgage-backed security trust, not a special situation. The filing is informational only, with no event triggering investment action.
